diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in zero allocations for every target facility, which is a trivial default state. The model was able to reach a valid (though unhelpful) settlement by simply assigning 0 units to everything, thereby avoiding any conflict with the specific numeric requirements of PF1, PF2, PF3, or PF4.
